task_description: Follow-up feature work on the existing cost-minimized serverless AWS quiz app (CDK v2 TypeScript, branch feat/cdk-scaffold). Four user requirements: (1) replace placeholder seed quizzes with ORIGINAL AWS-architecture design/implementation questions, at least one quiz with >= 10 questions, Japanese; (2) add an admin URL/page to register custom quizzes, backed by a new authenticated write API persisting into the existing DynamoDB single-table model; (3) admin authentication via Amazon Cognito (User Pool + Hosted UI + API Gateway v2 JWT authorizer on the admin write route; public read/submit routes stay open); (4) host the frontend via AWS Amplify Hosting ONLY (Hosting/CI-CD, not an Amplify Gen2 backend rebuild), rewiring the SPA to call the CDK-managed API cross-origin with CORS. Keep the cost-minimized/serverless spirit (no VPC/NAT, no provisioned capacity, no idle-billed resources). Network is INTEGRATIONS_ONLY in-sandbox (npm registry 403) so npm install / tsc / jest / cdk synth / cdk deploy CANNOT run here; all changes are correct-by-construction and verified by reading, with commands/console steps documented for the user's networked EC2 host. Commit onto feat/cdk-scaffold; do NOT push (orchestrator publishes, updating PR #1). No env-setup feature is included because the baseline is already green+reviewed from the prior completed task and in-sandbox install/build is impossible under INTEGRATIONS_ONLY.

review.summary: v1 semantic review returned APPROVED: all four user requirements met (original AWS-architecture seed quizzes with a 12-question set enforcing the >=10 guard via a build-time test; Cognito Hosted-UI admin page at /admin.html; Cognito-authenticated POST /api/admin/quizzes with the 3 public routes open; frontend moved to Amplify Hosting only). Security-critical answerIndex stripping (toPublicQuestions) untouched; cost constraints hold (PAY_PER_REQUEST, ARM64 Lambda, no VPC/NAT, no idle-billed resources). Five non-blocking findings. Two cheap first-deploy hardening items were then addressed in commit 80303b8: (finding #2) the localhost Cognito callback/logout URL is now gated behind the `includeLocalhostCallback` CDK context flag (set -c includeLocalhostCallback=false for production) instead of being trusted unconditionally; (finding #3) an ordered post-deploy setup checklist was added to the Japanese README. Remaining findings left as documented trade-offs appropriate for a cost-minimized demo: coarse authorization (any authenticated pool user is admin; safe because self-signup is disabled), allowOrigins ['*'] (documented, tighten to the Amplify domain once known), and time-suffix quizId generation with a 409 collision check (fine for the low-traffic admin path).

verification.summary: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network (npm registry 403, node_modules absent) makes npm ci / tsc / jest / cdk synth impossible in-sandbox; these are documented as commands the user runs on their networked EC2 host (env -u NODE_OPTIONS npm ci && npm run build && npm test && npx cdk synth). Feasible in-sandbox checks all pass: node --check passes on frontend/app.js, admin.js, config.js; amplify.yml is well-formed; the CDK stack has no dangling references to the removed S3/CloudFront resources and unused imports were removed; all new imports (aws-cdk-lib/aws-cognito, aws-cdk-lib/aws-apigatewayv2-authorizers) resolve within aws-cdk-lib (no new dependency). Test quality verified by reading: handler.test.ts imports the REAL exported scoreAnswers/toPublicQuestions/validateAndNormalizeQuizInput and SAMPLE_QUIZZES, so scoring, answer-stripping, admin-input validation, and the >=10-question seed requirement would all fail if regressed; quiz-app-stack.test.ts synthesizes the real stack and asserts the cost/security properties (DynamoDB PAY_PER_REQUEST, Lambda arm64, HTTP API, 4 routes with admin JWT-protected and public routes open, Cognito UserPool self-signup-disabled + public client, JWT authorizer, CORS allows the authorization header, and zero CloudFront/S3 resources + removed CloudFrontDomain output). No Dockerfile present.
